# Semrush

> Semrush is an AI-powered digital marketing platform providing unified solutions for SEO, PPC advertising, competitor analysis, and brand visibility across Google and AI search engines.

Semrush offers enterprise-grade tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, rank tracking, advertising optimization, and brand monitoring. The platform serves businesses of all sizes with integrated solutions for search visibility, content optimization, and marketing intelligence.

## Key Topics

- SEO Toolkit
- Keyword Research
- Backlink Analysis
- Competitor Analysis
- AI Search Optimization
- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- Brand Monitoring
- Rank Tracking
- Content Optimization
- Semrush One
- Enterprise Solutions
- Marketing Intelligence
- SERP Analysis
- Site Intelligence

## Core Platform Solutions

- [Semrush: Your Unfair Advantage for Growing Brand Visibility](https://www.semrush.com): Semrush homepage showcasing AI-powered SEO, PPC, and brand visibility platform
- [Semrush One - Win Every Search, From SEO to AI Discovery](https://www.semrush.com/one): Unified solution for Google and AI search optimization
- [Visibility for Global Brands - Semrush for Enterprise](https://enterprise.semrush.com): Enterprise-grade SEO and AI search platform with brand monitoring and intelligence

## SEO & Keyword Intelligence
